user_boundary: Container identifies either a full Scope Unit Path or a base Atom ID; no Draft or archived revision references are requested. Keep existing formal Relations and +>/<+ semantics unchanged.

scope_path.R2530: Path is one Property holding one or more string values, listing identities from root to addressed Scope Unit.
scope_path.R1661_R2689: Path/ancestry derives from Current Scope Unit declarations and direct parent chain; a display rendering is derived and does not establish parentage.
scope_path.R2526: Project root has no Scope Unit ID; a full identity chain cannot be rendered by assuming every segment is a Scope Unit ID.
scope_path.gap: These sources do not specify one canonical scalar textual rendering or separator for the whole chain. They do not make a filesystem path authoritative.

atom_identity.M450: Term ID is a unique identifier within matching prefix namespace; examples include versioned forms but do not establish lifecycle equivalence.
atom_identity.user_decision: CA-P-123 is base Atom ID; CA-P-123 refers to Current, CA-P-123@3 to Archived, and CA-P-123@3-draft to Draft. Proposed name AtomReference is analysis only; it has not been adopted as a Current Term or Format.
atom_identity.container_constraint: Accept base Atom ID as the Atom alternative; do not admit @version or @version-draft as Container values based on this decision.

formats.R2248_R2253: Existing string Format admits textual strings; identifying values use string with referenced object defined in source. No general ref Format is admitted.
formats.result: No separately named Current Atom ID, full Scope Unit Path string, or AtomReference Format was established by these inspected sources; do not invent new single-use grammar. Prose can state the permitted semantic alternatives, but not settle a missing concrete encoding.

first_blocking_question: How should the full root-to-unit Scope Unit identity chain be serialized in Header.Container: as an ordered list of identities, or as one string, and if one string what exact representation identifies the Project root and separates the identities?
candidate: None: the cardinality and representation of a Container value cannot be specified without the above answer.
limits: No filesystem path, versioned container, new Format, new Term, Current source, actual Draft, code or Git changes inferred.
